_comment: Paths that were published, are gone, and must stay gone.
ONE source of truth, read by three consumers, because the defect being
fixed here was exactly a path that was deleted in one place and kept
alive in two others. public/_redirects turns each of these into a real
404; scripts/build-sitemap.mjs refuses to list them; the IndexNow list is
derived from that sitemap, so it cannot resubmit them either.
tests/sitemap.test.ts asserts every entry here has a matching rule in
public/_redirects, so the two files cannot drift apart silently.
